name: Lucien Veritas
source:
Occupation: Court Ambassador
Age: Unknown
Height: 6'2
Alignment: True Neutral
Star Sign: Virgo
Characteristics: Alluring, mysterious, sarcastic
Affiliation: None

Lucien is the palace's demon ambassador; something which raises many eyebrows with the citizens of Novus. Why would the king and queen appoint such a creature to serve the crown, you ask? Well... Lucien isn't really sure that they know either, but they're definitely not going to question it. They're the epitome of mysterious, and they love to play games, just don't get on their bad side...

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lunarisgames/errant-kingdom]Kickstarter[/url]]

Lucien can be romanced on their own or as part of a polyamorous route with Raiden.
